title: NFRA_CTLPLN CT-d-5 + CT-a-1 -- BOX: THE LAPTOP. ONE untargeted safe-apply of infra/aws/terraform/nfra-ctlpln-identity creating EIGHT IAM objects: four managed policies (cloudops-dell-agent-respol-policy, -routes-fn-policy, -routes-host-policy, cloudops-dell2-agent-ssm-policy) and their four attachments (three to cloudops-dell-agents-group, one to the dell2 user). Three narrow the Dells (74 resource-policy actions; 33 functions / 12 documents / 5 prefixes reaching YES roles; dell2 shell+session documents). ONE widens: dell2 may send two FREE-TEXT resident documents to instance i-0167fd745ad906a66 as irpt-ycharts-runner-role, and read ANY command result on *. Both halves SIGNED: COO @14774dd9ff, CTO @eb74cfb2d2. Plan measured 8 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy; census fresh=True.
author: 0.7.0_AE_CloudOps~E

legs.target: one untargeted safe-apply of the identity root at the laptop
legs.proof_required: plan reads EXACTLY 8 to add / 0 to change / 0 to destroy with the eight named addresses as an EXACT SET MATCH (no ninth, none missing); derive_reached_roles.py --check-fresh read fresh=True before the plan; safe-apply completes 8 added 0 changed 0 destroyed

legs.target: the four live documents equal the rendered ones, and the attachment counts
legs.proof_required: each of the four LIVE default-version documents parses EQUAL to the document Terraform rendered (planted-mutant control through the same comparator); cloudops-dell-agents-group carries 5 managed policies and cloudops-dell2-agent-user carries 2, read live (BEFORE: 2 and 1)

legs.target: the nine arms of the simulation's SIXTH block, against the ATTACHED policies
legs.proof_required: dell2: each of the two resident documents to i-0167fd745ad906a66 allowed; a resident document to another instance refused; AWS-RunShellScript explicitDeny; the export render document explicitDeny; a document nothing grants refused; ssm:GetCommandInvocation allowed. dell1: the send refused; GetCommandInvocation refused. Every arm ATTRIBUTED by matched statement

legs.target: the five arms of the simulation's SEVENTH block (routes), against the ATTACHED policies
legs.proof_required: three explicitDeny, one per route kind (function code/config write, command-document write/send, s3:PutObject on a downloaded prefix); two allowed on NO roles as the controls that prove the Deny is scoped to YES roles and not blanket. Every arm ATTRIBUTED

legs.target: the resource-policy Deny arm and its control
legs.proof_required: one s3:PutBucketPolicy for a Dell user reads explicitDeny with the matched statement named DenyResourcePolicyWrites; and one create action the create policy allows still reads allowed as the control, so the Deny is not a blanket refusal

legs.target: AC1 + AC2 + AC3 and the six checks re-read
legs.proof_required: simulate_policy.py reads respol_ok=11/11 ssm_ok=9/9 routes_ok=5/5 all_ok=True (AC1); re-plan -detailed-exitcode reads exit=0 (AC2); check_identity.py reads names_from_builder=11/11 policy_size_ok=True ok=True (AC3); and the other three root checks re-read clean
